title: JSFL: doc.currentScene, doc.sceneCount, doc.currentTimeline missing/wrong
description: Three JSFL gaps from scene audit: (1) doc.currentScene is missing — Flash 8 JSFL returns { name, index, frameCount }. Add getter that returns { name: state.doc.scenes[state.sceneIndex].name, index: state.sceneIndex, frameCount: activeSceneFrameCount }. (2) doc.sceneCount is missing — add getter returning doc.timelines.length. (3) doc.currentTimeline always returns 0 — it should return state.sceneIndex. All three are in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts JsflDocument proxy.
